ops.when: Runs tasks continuously and reminds on deadlines
steps: creates the task and assigns an owner
moves it through statuses and holds the deadline
reminds and escalates when it slips

triage.when: Fires on every incoming item, before a person sees it
steps: takes the incoming item and extracts the point
checks it against the criteria and scores it
routes it to the right person or agent

reach.when: Picks the moment itself and does not let the pause drag on
steps: decides who to write to and when
prepares the touch with a real reason
records the reply and puts it back in play

analys.when: Calculates on schedule and on any question you ask
steps: pulls the data from the sources
calculates by the agreed model
explains the result in words and numbers

dialog.when: On your request, for as long as it takes
steps: holds the conversation and keeps the context
adapts the wording to the person
records what was agreed and the next step

craft.when: Starts on request, when a finished document is needed
steps: gathers the inputs from systems and conversations
prepares the document from your template
hands it to a person to check before it goes out

creat.when: On a brief for material, keeps the publishing plan
steps: works out the task and the audience
produces several options to choose from
edits on your notes until it is ready

watch.when: On duty around the clock, speaks only on deviation
steps: watches the source continuously
compares against the norm and the thresholds
raises the signal on deviation

stream.when: Runs constantly, reacts the moment a request arrives
steps: catches the request the moment it appears
handles it by the agreed scenario
passes the result down the chain

guard.when: Checks every action in the background, without you
steps: checks actions against the rules
logs the deviation
raises the case for review
